findings.text: red-team lens, medium: `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` is set to `false` inside `_cycle_orchestrator_run_body` before the iteration loop begins; because `cycle_dispatch_stage` is called from inside that same loop (not in a subshell), all stage dispatches in the resumed cycle run with `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false` exported to child processes — any plugin or nested orchestrator that inspects the flag during the actual resumed iteration will see `false`, making the flag unreliable as a 'this dispatch is part of a resume' signal for anything other than selecting `_start_iter`. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:2333; fix: design)
